title: Kutiman and Dekel's Hope, Jerk's As Day Breaks and Bril's Love in Times of Annihilation
description: Kutiman and Elran Dekel's new album Hope, Brooklyn multi-instrumentalist Jerk's EP As Day Breaks, and rapper Bril's Ahava BeYemei Kilayon.
author: Nir Hasson
intro: A comeback and a farewell, and three new records in between: two old friends who always make it work, a one-man band from Brooklyn, and an Israeli rapper who likes to push himself.

text: Hope is a new and beautiful album from Kutiman and Elran Dekel. The combination of the two always works, and it works on this album too.

albums.label: DeepMatter Records
text: Johnny Kinney, known as Jerk, is a composer, producer and multi-instrumentalist from Brooklyn. On his new EP he plays saxophone, flute, guitars, bass, Rhodes piano and synthesizer. The music blends jazz and funk with touches of jazz fusion and a little electronics.

"as day breaks" is the second part of a series, and the counterpart to his previous EP, "as night falls", released in November 2025. A fun album that can be perfect in the background, and even better when you really listen. Eight tracks, from "still dreaming" to "as long as i breathe".

albums.label: Netzach
text: Ahava BeYemei Kilayon (Love in Times of Annihilation) is a new album from the rapper Bril. A member of the group Pele Ozen, Bril is known for his sharp writing and his willingness to take on experimental projects and challenge himself.
Twelve tracks with guest appearances from Shir Gabay on "Bonanza" and Alona Haber on "Parpar Lavan" (White Butterfly), closing with "Akedat Ne'urim".
